create_patterns.content:
# Loaded nothing when the task has a bare plural

Trace t7: 'Move the alarm clocks on the desk to the drawer shelf.' The ground truth was pick_two_obj_and_place. Nothing was loaded. The task has no word 'two', so the plural noun is the only cue.

Other traces with an explicit 'two' also loaded nothing: t2, t3, t5 and t8.

Rule: if the object noun is plural, or the task says two, load pick_two_obj_and_place. Do not fall back to pick_and_place.

Evidence is aggregate only: all 8 traces loaded nothing, and baseline recall was 0 for every skill.

proposal.update_index:
- selection-loaded-nothing-for-plain-pick-and-place: single-object placement tasks, no skill loaded (t1, t4, t6).
- selection-loaded-nothing-for-two-object-placement: two-object tasks, no skill loaded (t2, t3, t5, t8).
- selection-loaded-nothing-for-bare-plural-two-object-task: a plural noun with no number word, no skill loaded (t7).
- selection-loaded-nothing-for-heat-or-clean-transform: heat or rinse tasks, no skill loaded. No trace in this batch.
proposal.append_log: Read t1-t8. Every trace loaded no skill. The ground truths were pick_and_place (t1, t4, t6) and pick_two_obj_and_place (t2, t3, t5, t7, t8). Added a bare-plural pattern for t7 and refreshed the index.
